Title: Rishabh and the Family

Cast

1. Rishabh - 9 years, son
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
2. Hema - 35 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Vikram - 36 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
4. Nikhil - 10 years, friend
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Hema, Vikram and Nikhil stand near him.]

Vikram: "What lovely weather!"

[Rishabh slips and falls.]

Nikhil (laughing): "That's easy."

[Rishabh trips over a stone.]

Rishabh: "Wow, how lovely!"

[Rishabh hurts his knee.]

Rishabh: "What next?"

[Rishabh helps Mother get up.]

Vikram: "Exactly right."

[Rishabh coughs.]

Rishabh: "Okay, Nikhil."

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Rishabh stands in the living room. Hema and Nikhil stand near him.]

Nikhil: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh puts on his school uniform.]

Rishabh (excited): "Mom, are you okay?"

[Rishabh puts on his shoes and ties the laces.]

Hema: "That's great!"

[Rishabh munches on an apple.]

Nikhil: "That's great!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Hema and Vikram stand near him.]

Vikram: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh dances to the music.]

Rishabh: "That's easy."

[Rishabh hugs Mother tightly.]

Rishabh: "Show me too!"

[Rishabh waves goodbye to Mother.]

Rishabh: "Hmm, I see."

[Rishabh shakes his head.]

Hema: "I knew it!"

[Rishabh shouts angrily.]

Rishabh (surprised): "This is amazing!"

[Rishabh gives Mother a flower.]

Rishabh: "What happened?"

Scene 4: The road - Day

[Rishabh stands by the road. Hema and Vikram stand near him.]

Vikram: "What a nice place."

[Rishabh gets into the car.]

Hema (gently): "Really?"

[Rishabh hops into an auto-rickshaw.]

Vikram: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
